title: All Finishers and Counters gui KEYLESS
features: Has a gui that has two tabs one for finishers which has almost every finisher that you can use with characters that don’t have it also has one for counters where you just go up to someone and click it (it’s spamable) USE SPRINGTRAP COUNTER OR DOME OTHERS TO GET OUT OF BRING STUCK
script:
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TwiRwal/TwiWare/main/uilib.lua"))()

local window = Library.CreateLib("Move Hub", "Midnight")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local characters = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Characters", 8)

-- Finishers Tab
local finisherTab = window:NewTab("Finishers")
local finisherSection = finisherTab:NewSection("All Finishers")

-- Counters Tab
local counterTab = window:NewTab("Counters")
local counterSection = counterTab:NewSection("All Counters")

for _, charFolder in pairs(characters:GetChildren()) do
    local remotes = charFolder:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    if remotes then
        for _, remote in pairs(remotes:GetChildren()) do
            local nameLower = remote.Name:lower()
            local charName = charFolder.Name
            local moveName = remote.Name

            if string.find(nameLower, "finisher") then
                print("✅ Finisher: " .. charName .. " → " .. moveName)
                finisherSection:NewButton(charName .. " - " .. moveName, "Use " .. moveName, function()
                    local r = remotes:FindFirstChild(moveName)
                    if r then
                        r:FireServer(player)
                        print("✅ Fired: " .. charName .. " - " .. moveName)
                    end
                end)
            elseif string.find(nameLower, "counter") then
                print("✅ Counter: " .. charName .. " → " .. moveName)
                counterSection:NewButton(charName .. " - " .. moveName, "Use " .. moveName, function()
                    local r = remotes:FindFirstChild(moveName)
                    if r then
                        r:FireServer(player)
                        print("✅ Fired: " .. charName .. " - " .. moveName)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end
